meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频镜头加上推拉缩放与镜头运动动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让视频片段有缩放、推拉或镜头运动等动画效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, and camera-move keyframes to video shots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're animating zooms, punch-ins, or camera moves inside video shots.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 HyperFrames 合成写 seek-safe 关键帧:推进/拉远、缩放、重构图、Ken Burns、镜头移动、遮罩转场等视觉动作,并用 hyperframes keyframes 等命令验证。
howto.when: 当一段 HyperFrames 合成需要推进/拉远、缩放、镜头移动等 2D/3D 关键帧时接管;不用于整体场景策略、品牌设计、素材挑选或字幕。

say.text: 给这个片段加一个从 1.0 推到 1.3 的推进镜头,主体保持不变。
say.note: 会在片段内的 wrapper 上写 scale/位移关键帧

say.text: 把这段改成平滑的 Ken Burns 移动,最后定格几帧。
say.note: 用姿势阶梯关键帧并延长末尾保持

say.text: 跑 hyperframes keyframes 检查这段动画,并截关键帧验证。
say.note: 列出关键帧目标与时间点,输出截图

howto.what_en: Claude writes seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames compositions: punch-in/out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns, camera moves, masks, and handoffs, then verifies them with hyperframes keyframes diagnostics.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in, zoom, camera moves, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes. Not for scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, or captions.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in from 1.0 to 1.3 scale on this clip, keeping the subject.
say_en.note: Writes scale/translate keyframes on an inner wrapper

say_en.text: Turn this into a smooth Ken Burns move and hold a few frames at the end.
say_en.note: Uses a pose ladder with a longer final hold

say_en.text: Run hyperframes keyframes on this animation and snapshot the proof frames.
say_en.note: Lists targets and stops, writes shot files
